title: DTU RAVEN Wins the California UAS Competition 2026
excerpt: DTU RAVEN finished in 1st place at C-UASC 2026, completing all planned missions and setting the best scores in waypoint navigation accuracy and the time trial.
content:
The final day is done, and we are proud to share that DTU RAVEN finished in 1st place at the California UAS Competition 2026.

Across the three days we successfully completed all of our planned missions, including payload drop and delivery, target localization, precision waypoint navigation, and the time trial.

We did not just win by performing well across the board, we also placed best of all teams in waypoint navigation accuracy and set the time to beat on the time trial.

With a lean and focused team, we were always ready for our next flight slot, staying locked on the task at hand and each contributing their part to the drone's performance.

A massive thank you to California State University, Los Angeles for hosting this fantastic event. Thank you to our sponsors Tuborgfondet and dane-rc.dk, and to our workshop hosts at DTU Skylab. And of course, thank you to the Technical University of Denmark for supporting our mission of bridging the gap between academia and industry in autonomous systems, and for backing engineering students learning and working in this field.

The future is bright for RAVEN as we take on new platforms and grow our team and mission. If you would like to be part of this future, either as a team member or industry partner, please do not hesitate to reach out!
